katie-cs: FYI Acme customer seeing intermittent "invalid_scope" and occasional 401 during SDK init on iOS. Happens ~1 in 4 attempts. Attaching logs. Anyone seen token scope checks fail only on mobile?

maria-cs: They say it spikes during onboarding when many devices hit at once. Suspect token refresh churn. TTL is 8s for ephemeral tokens.

josh-eng: Can you paste a small log sample? Also does SDK do concurrent refreshes? If multiple threads all refresh at the same time it can cause temporary token exchanges and preflight failures.

katie-cs: log:
```
[2025-02-14T15:32:12Z] client_id=acme-123 status=401 err="invalid_scope: scope 'embed.read' missing"
[2025-02-14T15:32:12Z] sdk=mobile init_retry=0 token_ttl=8ms_refresh=0
```

samir-sre: 8s TTL is brutal. Also check device clocks — if iat/nbf validation strict +/-5s, clock skew can make a freshly minted token appear not yet valid. Mobile devices often have drift.

josh-eng: Also the SDK retry logic looks aggressive. If many clients refresh at token expiry you'll get a refresh stampede and some requests race with token issuance -> 401/invalid_scope if token rotation hasn't finished. Two mitigations: 1) increase TTL to 60s; 2) singleflight/dedupe refresh so only one network call per process; 3) add jitter to refresh timing.

maria-cs: We can ask Acme to push a quick patch to their iOS SDK to add jitter and a singleflight guard. Want me to share a patch snippet?

josh-eng: yes please. Something like:
```
// pseudo
if (refreshInFlight) await refreshPromise
else refreshPromise = doRefresh()
refreshPromise.then(clear)
// refresh window: expire - random(0..2000ms)
```

katie-cs: Also can we relax server-side nbf window temporarily for this customer? Say allow -10s skew for onboarding ramp? Only for their account.

samir-sre: We can add a per-account skew tolerance toggle in the auth layer. Low risk if audited. I'll open a config ticket and enable for acme-123 for next 24h.

integrations-bot: support-ticket #32491 created -> AUTH-TOGGLE-32491 by samir-sre

maria-cs: Acme patched SDK with jitter + singleflight, testing now.

katie-cs: update: after the patch retries dropped and errors went from ~25% -> ~2%. Acme will keep TTL at 30s for now. Thanks team! :tada:

josh-eng: Nice. Follow-up: add default SDK change to backoff+singleflight in next minor release. Filed RFC.

katie-cs: closing loop. CC @samir-sre will revert skew toggle in 24h if stable.
